Convert a dense network object to the sparse representation

Source: R/network-sparse.R
as_sparse_network.Rd

Thresholds the dense co-expression matrix at the store_density quantile. Repacks the surviving off-diagonal entries (both triangles) as a Matrix::dgCMatrix, as compute_network(sparse = TRUE) does.

Usage

as_sparse_network(net, store_density = 0.05)

Arguments

net

Dense network object: output of compute_network(sparse = FALSE), or a hand-built list(network = <matrix>, threshold = ) with gene dimnames.

store_density

Fraction of top edges to keep in the store (default 0.05). Must be in (0, 1) and, when the network records its density in params$density, at least that density (the store must contain every analysis edge).

Value

The network object with network as a dgCMatrix plus store_density and store_threshold fields.

Details

All other fields of net are carried over. store_density, store_threshold and params$store_density are added. Values below store_threshold are discarded, so downstream analyses at a lower threshold are refused.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
net <- compute_network(x, density = 0.03, sparse = FALSE)
net_sparse <- as_sparse_network(net, store_density = 0.05)
} # }
